name: Alertness Draught
description: For a scene, the drinker cannot be surprised and notices small details. Afterward they are irritable and cannot sleep for a night.

name: Calm Tonic
description: The drinker's fear or anger fades for a scene. The cause remains, and the feeling returns sharper when the tonic wears off.

name: Fire-Breath
description: The drinker can breathe a short cone of flame once within the next minute. The potion tastes of sulphur and leaves the mouth raw.

name: Inkblood
description: For an hour, the drinker can read any writing they touch, including faded, coded, or hidden text. The reading is literal and gives no context.

name: Memory Tea
description: The drinker recalls one memory with perfect clarity, as if living it again. The memory is true as they saw it, not as it happened.

name: Growth Serum
description: A plant, small animal, or cut of wood grows to twice its size for a day. It needs food and water to match, and it may not shrink back evenly.

name: Truth Serum
description: For a scene, the drinker cannot knowingly lie. They can still refuse to answer, answer a different question, or say what they believe is true.

name: Sleep Dust
description: A pinch sends one person into a deep sleep for a scene. A loud noise or a hard shake wakes them. It does not work on the unwilling twice.

name: Shield Salve
description: Rubbed on the skin, it turns the next cut or burn aside for a scene. It smells of tar and leaves a grey stain for a day.

name: Featherweight
description: For a scene, the drinker weighs a tenth of their weight and can drift down from a height. They are easy to push and hard to anchor.

name: Loudmouth
description: The drinker's voice becomes impossibly loud for a minute. It can call across a valley or shatter glass, and it cannot whisper.

name: Night-Eye
description: For a night, the drinker sees clearly in near-darkness. Bright light hurts, and colours are washed out.

name: Luckdrop
description: The next roll the drinker makes in the next hour treats a 6- as a 7-9. The drop is rare, and the ingredient list is closely watched.

name: Smoke Flask
description: Thrown or uncorked, it fills a room with thick smoke for a scene. Everyone inside is blinded and coughing, including the thrower unless they hold their breath.

name: Mending Paste
description: Spread on a broken object, it holds the pieces together for a day. It is not a repair, and the object fails again when the paste dries.
